provenance.tool: SQLsmith (automated random query generator for PostgreSQL)

trigger.statement: select (select pg_catalog.avg(actu_codi) from public.actualizar_sistema) as c0, sample_0.radi_nume_temp as c1, sample_0.radi_usua_ante as c2, (select anex_borrado from public.anexos limit 1 offset 4) as c3, pg_catalog.pg_stat_get_buf_alloc() as c4 from public.radicado as sample_0 tablesample bernoulli (9.7) where (sample_0.radi_texto = cast(nullif(sample_0.radi_inst_actu, sample_0.radi_usua_radi) as int4)) or (cast(null as jsonb) ?& case when sample_0.radi_imagen is not NULL then cast(null as _text) else cast(null as _text) end) limit 33;

replay_verification.requirement: Must crash consecutively 5 out of 5 runs with identical crash signature on clean state
replay_verification.isolation: clean per-candidate database reset before each replay
